shell.title: Privacy Policy
shell.description: This starter policy is a placeholder. Review it with the laws, ethics, and tools that apply to your counselling practice.

sections.title: Information submitted through forms
sections.body: This template includes contact and consultation forms. Before using the site with clients, connect those forms to a secure form provider or backend that matches your privacy and professional obligations.

sections.title: How information is used
sections.body: Information submitted through a live form should only be used to respond to inquiries, coordinate consultations, and provide services requested by the visitor.

sections.title: Health information
sections.body: Avoid asking visitors to submit detailed personal health information through a general website form. Use secure clinical systems for intake forms, records, and ongoing care.

sections.title: Third-party services
sections.body: If you add analytics, scheduling, email marketing, or payment tools, update this policy to name those services and explain how they handle information.
